standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Use parentheses, brackets or braces in expressions and evaluate them.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Write simple expressions and interpret them without evaluating (3 × (18,932 + 921) is three times as large as 18,932 + 921).

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Generate two number patterns from two rules, form ordered pairs and graph them.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: A digit is worth 10 times as much as the same digit one place to its right, and 1/10 of the place to its left.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Explain patterns when multiplying or dividing by powers of 10; use exponents for powers of 10.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Read, write and compare decimals to thousandths, including expanded form.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Round decimals to any place.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Multiply multi-digit whole numbers fluently with the standard method.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Divide up to 4-digit numbers by 2-digit numbers.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Add, subtract, multiply and divide decimals to hundredths.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Add and subtract fractions and mixed numbers with unlike denominators.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Solve fraction word problems; use benchmark fractions to check if answers are reasonable.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Understand a fraction as division (3/4 = 3 ÷ 4) and solve sharing problems.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction; find areas of rectangles with fraction side lengths.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Understand multiplication as scaling: multiplying by a fraction greater or less than 1.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Solve real-world problems by multiplying fractions and mixed numbers.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Divide unit fractions by whole numbers and whole numbers by unit fractions.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Convert units within one measurement system and use conversions in multi-step problems.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Make line plots with fractions of a unit and solve problems using them.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Understand volume: unit cubes fill solid figures.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Measure volume by counting unit cubes.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Find volume with V = l × w × h and V = B × h; add volumes of two boxes.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Use a coordinate system: the x-axis, the y-axis and ordered pairs.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Graph points in the first quadrant to solve real-world problems.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Attributes of a category of shapes belong to all subcategories (all rectangles have four right angles, so squares do too).

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Make sense of problems and keep at them.

standards.subject: math
standards.summary: Explain your reasoning and find mistakes in other people's reasoning.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Quote accurately from a text when explaining what it says and when drawing inferences.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Find a theme, including how characters respond to challenges or how a speaker reflects; summarize.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Compare and contrast two characters, settings or events, using specific details.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Find the meaning of words and phrases, including figurative language like metaphors and similes.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Explain how chapters, scenes or stanzas fit together to give a story, play or poem its structure.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Describe how a narrator's or speaker's point of view influences how events are described.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Analyze how visual and multimedia elements add to a text's meaning, tone or beauty.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Compare stories in the same genre on their approaches to similar themes and topics.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Read and understand grade 4–5 literature by the end of the year (reading range over the whole year).

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Quote accurately from a text when explaining it and drawing inferences.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Find two or more main ideas and explain how details support them; summarize.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Explain relationships between two or more people, events or ideas in a text.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Find the meaning of academic and subject words in a grade 5 text.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Compare the structure (time order, comparison, cause and effect, problem and solution) of two or more texts.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Analyze multiple accounts of the same event, noting similarities and differences in point of view.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Draw on several print or digital sources to find an answer or solve a problem quickly.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Explain how an author uses reasons and evidence to support points.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Combine information from several texts on the same topic.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Read and understand grade 4–5 informational texts by the end of the year (reading range over the whole year).

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Use letter-sound knowledge, syllables and word parts (roots and affixes) to read unfamiliar words.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Read aloud accurately and smoothly, with expression (checked by a grown-up: see Reading fluency in Parents).

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Write opinion pieces with a clear claim, logically ordered reasons, facts and details, and a conclusion.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Write informative texts with a clear focus, grouped information, precise words, transitions and a conclusion.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Write narratives with dialogue, description, pacing, transitions and a resolution.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Produce clear, organized writing that fits the task and audience (longer pieces, checked by a teacher).

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Plan, revise, edit and rewrite.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Use technology to produce, publish and collaborate; type at least two pages in one sitting.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Do short research projects using several sources.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Gather information from sources, summarize or paraphrase it, and list sources.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Use evidence from texts to support analysis and research.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Write routinely over short and long time frames.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Take part in group discussions, building on others' ideas.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Summarize a text read aloud or information presented in media.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Summarize a speaker's points and explain how reasons and evidence support each claim.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Report on a topic or present an opinion, speaking clearly at a good pace.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Include multimedia and visual displays in presentations.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Adapt speech to different situations, using formal English when appropriate.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Grammar: conjunctions, prepositions and interjections; perfect verb tenses; using tense to show time; fixing tense shifts; correlative conjunctions.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Commas in a series, after introductory words and in direct address; titles of works; spelling.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Expand, combine and reduce sentences; compare varieties of English used in stories.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Figure out unknown words from context, Greek and Latin roots and affixes, and reference materials.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Figurative language (similes, metaphors), idioms, adages, proverbs, synonyms, antonyms and homographs.

standards.subject: ela
standards.summary: Learn and use grade-level academic and subject words.

standards.summary: Patterns: daily changes in shadows, day and night, and seasonal stars.

standards.summary: Communities use science ideas to protect Earth's resources and environment.

standards.summary: Compare several possible solutions to a problem.

standards.subject: science
standards.summary: Plan fair tests and use the results to improve a design.
